title:
The Landings activity hub 25.07.25 

On today’s morning session tenants participated in a songwriting session. 

Tenants used a brainstorming method to connect words that would suit a love song 🎵 
❤️

Songwriting offers a wide range of benefits, including improved mental and emotional well-being, enhanced creativity, and increased self-esteem. It provides a powerful outlet for expressing emotions, processing experiences, and fostering resilience. Additionally, songwriting can boost cognitive skills, improve social interactions, and even offer a meditative experience.
